text:
maria: Quick sync: ACME wants a private marketplace listing that combines a 12mo commit + a hardware voucher (appliance discount) and a staged renewal discount ladder. They asked for partner co-branding and a joint press blurb. Can partnerships ops sketch pricing + renewal mechanics?

sam: +1. We need a clear staircase so procurement can see savings over time. propose baseline: 18% off for base commit, step-up to 26% at mid-tier, 34% at enterprise tier. hardware voucher should be a separate line item (voucher code) redeemable through our HW partner portal.

lucas: technical question: will the voucher be applied by marketplace flow or handled entirely by the partner (outside-marketplace redemption)? marketplace prefers outside redemption for hardware. that affects how we show net price on the private offer.

frank: finance: if voucher is outside-marketplace, we must record the HW subsidy as contra-revenue (not a marketplace discount) so ARR math isn't skewed. need contractual language for amortization and an excel model for recognition.

maria: legal-bot: any red flags for co-branded announcement + voucher?

legal-bot: Legal: co-branding ok with partner approval. voucher terms must include expiry (90 days post-activation), non-transferability, and a clawback if commit not met. also need to ensure IP and logo usage terms in the joint announcement.

sam: okay to include 90-day voucher expiry. On renewal staircase: thinking of a "carry-forward" credit if customer overpays commit in yr1 — do we allow consumption carry-forward to yr2? procurement often asks.

frank: carry-forward complicates revenue recognition and makes forecasting harder. prefer a one-time settlement or applying excess as a prepaid credit in yr2 with clear amortization. avoid open-ended carry-forward.

lucas: ops: marketplace private-offer metadata needs fields: sku, commit-amount, discount-percentage, voucher-id (nullable), announcement-url. i'll draft the JSON schema we push to the marketplace API.

maria: can we offer an early-renew incentive in the PO: if ACME renews before 90 days to the next tier, give an additional 3% on top of ladder? sales loves that.

frank: finance: early-renew incentive ok but must be conditioned on invoice timing and have cap (e.g., max $40k). will define cap matrix.

legal-bot: i'll insert an early-renew addendum template with the cap and the clause: "early-renew incentives apply only if renewal executed and invoiced within 90 days prior to contract expiration."

marketplace-bot: Note: draft private offer created in staging: po-ACME-2024-1732109999. Review threads appended to the draft will be visible to marketplace reviewers.

maria: plan: i'll assemble pricing ladder + voucher handling options (marketplace vs partner redemption) + renewal rules and circulate by tomorrow. please flag any deal-breakers asap. tagging @sam @lucas @frank. Thanks. :sparkles:
